policy: Evidence-based diagnostics; pattern matching is not proof of root cause; no autonomous fixes or external commands.

cases.title: Hugo theme config schema mismatch
cases.regex: dateFormat.*type string|colorScheme.*type string|can't evaluate field .* in type string
cases.advice: Check theme version and params shape; restore nested tables expected by active theme

cases.title: Hugo template or partial missing
cases.regex: partial .*not found|template .* not defined|failed to render pages|render of .* failed
cases.advice: Inspect first nested template error, check layouts override precedence and version compatibility

cases.title: Hugo Go module resolution
cases.regex: failed to download modules|module .*not found|module declares its path as|unknown revision|checksum mismatch
cases.advice: Check go.mod, go.sum, module path/version and network; never bypass checksum verification

cases.title: Dart Sass missing or incompatible
cases.regex: no Dart Sass binary|TOCSS-DART|unexpected EOF when executing .sass.
cases.advice: Install official Dart Sass executable required by Hugo and verify PATH; not just npm sass CLI

cases.title: Hugo version mismatch
cases.advice: Compare Hugo Extended version with theme module minimum and action setup

cases.title: Missing generated assets or resources
cases.regex: missing-asset|resource .*not found|failed to execute resource|get resource .*nil
cases.advice: Check asset pipeline, image/resource paths, GitHub Pages baseURL and pathprefix

cases.title: JavaScript parse error
cases.advice: Run node --check on changed JavaScript; inspect source and avoid retrying unchanged code

cases.title: Expected route missing
cases.advice: Inspect page front matter, drafts, menu links, permalink config and published public directory

cases.title: GitHub Actions permission restriction
cases.regex: Resource not accessible by integration|403 Forbidden|owner marked spam|workflow is not permitted
cases.advice: Inspect token scopes, repository restrictions and account-level blocks; do not assume quota issue

cases.title: GitHub Pages deployment error
cases.regex: deploy-pages.*failed|Failed to deploy|Pages build and deployment|Artifact not found
cases.advice: Inspect deploy job logs, Pages environment, artifact paths and permissions

cases.title: Temporary network/API quota
cases.regex: 429 Too Many Requests|rate limit exceeded|connection reset|TLS handshake timeout|503 Service Unavailable|502 Bad Gateway
cases.advice: Retry bounded with backoff; use API snapshot/cache fallback when appropriate

cases.title: PR branch conflict
cases.advice: Compare latest main, resolve conflict preserving newer content; rerun Bug Checker

postmortem_schema.evidence_rule: Verified cause, solution and outcome required; never derive root cause from CI success alone.
